sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 5 月 15 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MSFT、SPY、NVDA、OPEX、PE。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日市场（截至发稿）SPY 下跌约 1.18%，道指下跌 -0.8%（-400 点），纳斯达克指数下跌 -1.54%（-456 点），这是 3 月 27 日以来罕见的“大幅”红日。三大因素同时施压：

  • Trump-Xi Beijing Summit yields zero substance: Trump claimed to have reached "fantastic trade deals," but NYT, BBC, and Reuters unanimously reported "no major breakthroughs." On the Iran issue, Xi refused any mediation or pressure, and on the Taiwan issue, Xi personally set the tone as the "most important topic." The community's interpretation was extremely sharp—"the high-profile CEO delegation brought photo ops instead of contracts," and the so-called 750 Boeing order was mocked as LMAO material for "This is the greatest trade deal ever signed."
  • Oil and long-term bonds go haywire in sync: Brent touched $109, WTI stood above $104, the 10Y yield surged to 4.55% (a one-year high), and the 30Y expanded further above 5%. The transmission chain of "oil + yields ripping → tech valuation kill" finally played out today.
  • JPow's final day: Powell's term ends today, with Warsh taking over next Monday. The market gave a red screen instead of a red carpet on his farewell day, which the community views as the bond market pricing in the new chairman's dovish tendencies ahead of time ("bond vigilantes resurrected").

恐惧/贪婪：从昨天的 70+ 贪婪迅速回落至 45 中性范围。真正的恐慌尚未出现——评论仍以“V文”、“抄底”、“看涨”为主流肌肉反应，语气是“-1%就你了？”势不可挡。然而，少数派的言论明显升级，开始认真讨论“全球信贷市场自取其辱”、“债券市场夫妻离婚文件”、“美国资产3-5年无法投资”等问题。

WSB 情绪与实际表现：今天是过去六周中罕见的一天，社区情绪落后于实际市场走势。开盘前半个小时，大家都在等V，上午11点等V，中午等特朗普推文，临近收盘时，还在等“上帝蜡烛”。但实际市场被钉在 SPY 740 附近，双方 0DTE 归零，theta 团伙清理干净。这不是“崩盘”，而是“V形信念与价格停滞”之间信念修正的第一天。

BABA4看跌盈利后收益完全被抹去
